reactions: [Hacker News] Not going to use Twitter without Nitter, so I'll just assume that's good news. Maybe I can finally delete that useless symlink to the actual AGENTS.md.

[Hacker News] It took the Shopify CEO tweet and Astra causing a large move towards Codex for them to finally give in. It's hard to believe it was worth it in the end. On the other hand, most people will forget about this saga in a few months, so sadly it may just have been worth it.
